newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Mackie says wins 3.4 mln stg UK contract.
newsitem.headline: Mackie says wins 3.4 mln stg UK contract.

text.p: Northern Ireland's Mackie International Plc said on Monday its unit Mackie Environmental had secured a contract worth 3.4 million stg from Severn Trent Water.
Mackie said in a statement that the contract, for engineering work at Derby Sewage Treatment Works, had been "won in tender against strong competition."
"This contract, set for delivery during next year, gives Mackie Environmental an excellent foundation for meeting its 1997 growth projections," the company said.
"Mackie Environmental will continue to expand in the medium to long term and will become a major contributor to group profits," it said.
